question: In chemical industries, bleaching powder is used as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**an oxidising agent**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Bleaching powder (Calcium hypochlorite) is a strong oxidising agent, which means it can donate oxygen to other substances and oxidize them.
 
• It is commonly used in chemical industries for bleaching paper pulp, textiles, and disinfecting drinking water due to its ability to kill bacteria and other pathogens.
 
• Bleaching powder releases chlorine when exposed to air and moisture, which contributes to its oxidising properties.
 
• It is widely used in the textile industry to bleach cotton and linen and in the paper industry to bleach wood pulp.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Oxidising Agents**

 
 
• Oxidising agents are substances that can accept electrons and bring about oxidation of other substances.
 
• Common oxidising agents include substances like hydrogen peroxide, potassium permanganate, and chlorine.
 
• They are used in various industrial processes including disinfection, bleaching, and water treatment.
 
 
 
• **Calcium Hypochlorite**
 
 
• Calcium hypochlorite, commonly known as bleaching powder, is a white solid, often used for water treatment and as a bleaching agent.
 
• Its chemical formula is Ca(ClO)₂.
 
• It is more stable than sodium hypochlorite (liquid bleach) and has a longer shelf life.
 
 
 
• **Disinfection Process**
 
 
• Disinfection involves the elimination of most or all pathogenic microorganisms, except bacterial spores, from inanimate objects.
 
• Bleaching powder is used to disinfect drinking water and swimming pools by killing harmful microorganisms.
 
 
 
• **Safety Measures**
 
 
• When handling bleaching powder, it is important to use protective gear, such as gloves and masks, to avoid irritation and inhalation of fumes.
 
• It should be stored in a dry, cool place away from organic materials and acids to prevent hazardous reactions.
